review.why: The PR removes the application-level email uniqueness validation that prevents users from registering or updating their profile with an email already in use, relying solely on a database constraint which will surface as a 500 error instead of a clear 400 validation error.

suspicions.claim: Registering a new user with an email that already exists in the database now returns a 500 Internal Server Error (database integrity error) instead of a 400 validation error with message 'Use a different email.'
suspicions.trigger: Send POST /api/users with JSON body {"username": "newuser", "email": "alice@example.com", "password": "password"} where alice@example.com already exists in the seeded database (user alice). Observe response status 500 and error body with code 500 instead of 400 with validation error.
suspicions.evidence: POST /api/users with duplicate email returned 400 validation error in base but 500 UNIQUE constraint error in head

suspicions.claim: Updating the authenticated user's profile to an email that already exists in the database now returns a 500 Internal Server Error (database integrity error) instead of a 400 validation error with message 'Use a different email.'.
suspicions.trigger: Authenticate as user bob (password doppel-pass) via POST /api/tokens, save access_token. Send PUT /api/me with Authorization: Bearer <token> and JSON body {"email": "alice@example.com"} where alice@example.com already exists. Observe response status 500 and error body with code 500 instead of 400 with validation error.
suspicions.evidence: No probe reached PUT /api/me with duplicate email trigger

suspicions.claim: Registering a new user with an email that differs only by case (e.g., ALICE@EXAMPLE.COM vs alice@example.com) now returns a 500 Internal Server Error due to database unique constraint violation on the case-sensitive email column, whereas previously the case-insensitive application-level check would
suspicions.trigger: Send POST /api/users with JSON body {"username": "newuser2", "email": "ALICE@EXAMPLE.COM", "password": "password"} where alice@example.com (lowercase) already exists in the seeded database. Observe response status 500 and error body with code 500 instead of 400 with validation error.
suspicions.evidence: No probe reached POST /api/users with case-different email trigger

suspicions.claim: Updating the authenticated user's profile to an email that differs only by case from an existing email now returns a 500 Internal Server Error due to database unique constraint violation, whereas previously the case-insensitive application-level check would have caught it and returned a 400 validati
